scenes.alt:
We have dumped JAX/SGLang and rewritten the entire RL and inference stack from scratch in C/C++, which took some extra time.
Training (aka pre-training) is done. Lot of cleanup was needed on the SFT data to get that mostly right.
Now, 4.8 is in RL and the evals are starting to climb.
We will do a soft rollout to Bot users later this week and see how it goes.
Grok 4.8 will bear no resemblance to 4.7 (thankfully). It is not yet incredible, but, this time, the foundations are built right, so I expect it to evolve to be something special.

The Last Sibyl of the Unborn Cathedral: an adult alien goddess reclining on a fractured altar grown from her own nervous system, monumental sensual curves veiled in translucent organza and tarnished ceremonial gold, elongated skull tilted back in oracular ecstasy, a broken eclipse as halo. Slender fingers gather copper nerves from her abdomen  branching into ribs, pillars, distant vaults. Black tendrils float upward bearing tiny votive bells; beneath her hand, a split pomegranate spills garnet seeds into an extinguished censer. Her body sustains the sanctuary as its arches crumble. Epic Old Master allegorical portrait, Venetian sumptuousness, Baroque devotional terror, deep chiaroscuro, luminous flesh glazed over umber, oxblood drapery, oxidized copper, smoky indigo, pale ochre. Ancient biomechanical ornament like reliquary metal. Oil painting dissolving at margins into charcoal pentimenti and scraped pigment; architecture bleeding into anatomy; radical negative space above; beauty approaching structural collapse.

A line graph titled "The cursing Pareto frontier" plots the VALS Index (vertical axis, ranging from 50 to 75) against the percentage of runs with a swear word on a log scale (horizontal axis, ranging from 0.1% to 10%). The "CURSING FRONTIER" slopes downward from left to right, connecting models such as DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017 and GLM 5.3 at lower swearing frequencies (around 0.1%) to MiMo V2.6 Pro and MiMo V2.6 Flash at higher frequencies (around 10%). A horizontal dashed line indicates the "BEST MODEL THAT NEVER SWORE" at a VALS index of approximately 71. Additional data points labeled DeepSeek V4 Pro 0813, Hy4 Preview, Kimi K3, Inkling 2 Small, and GLM 5.3 Flash are scattered below the frontier line.

SemiAnalysis InferenceX line chart comparing Nov. 5 and Nov. 10, 2026 benchmarks for Qwen3.8 Flash Next 176B on Vera Rubin NVL72 with Dynamo SGLang. The chart plots total agentic tokens per dollar of ownership cost against P90 end-to-end latency. The Nov. 10 run delivers 12.9× as many tokens per dollar at about 4.5 seconds, 1.59× at 11 seconds, and 2.49× at 19 seconds, where it reaches roughly 490 million tokens per dollar versus 200 million on Nov. 5. The Nov. 10 curve levels off near 625 million tokens per dollar around 28 seconds. Results are preliminary.
